title: Valorvales - A survivorlike where you can freely switch between party members
author: iElementals
selftext:
Hello,

I am working on a game where you can create a party with the heroes that you have unlocked and you can switch between party members, it seems like an interesting concept to me. It is super early but i wanted to share because tbh its kinda lonely making a game by myself. If you're interested in following my game progress or working on a similar project and just want to chat, i would love to connect.

Thanks!

comments.author: SimCFB
comments.body:
Wheres the link homie? looks really nice

What did you use to build it? How long did it take you?

replies.author: iElementals
replies.body: I dont have a steam page or a gamepage yet, i included a discord link for a server that i made for the game but i think that made the post flagged as spam or something so i removed it. I used claude, chatgpt and unity. It took about a month so far on and off.

comments.author: Jeek126
comments.body: And which subscription do you have? The expensive one? Do you also vibecoded all the assets? I like it

replies.author: iElementals
replies.body: No, just the 20/month on both and assets are from the unity store, just a bunch of free vfx too
